tail:
Batch 39 is authored: 20 carriers (16 A items and 4 B examples), with dependency levels 0–4. The A/B pages, manifest, coverage, proof contracts and batch notes are updated.

The strict proof-contract check passes for all 20 items and 72 steps. Precheck passes all 17 proof-bearing items; proof-layout reports 0 defects across 20 carriers; rendercheck passes 22 files. Focused dependency, content-policy and source-fetch checks pass.

Readiness records mark 16 items ready and 4 escalated. The escalations concern missing standard-mesh \(L^2\)-projector \(W^{1,p}\)-stability; the convergence claims remain explicitly conditional. The proposed supplier and affected claims are recorded in the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-batch-39.notes.md) and [monotone FEM decision record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-analysis-remaining-71-2026-10-17-step1-thm-pe12-monotone-fem-limit.json).

The run-wide dependency-level check still reports 66 empty inventories and 10 stale labels on other batches’ Delaunay items; this batch’s manifest passes independently. The Roubíček source has a documented drop with alternative proofs. The earlier Vázquez retrieval history lacks exact URLs and search strings, so it is recorded only at host and outcome level; the porous-medium example is proved locally.
